name: The Smokey Vault
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24 >/dev/null; nvm alias default 24 >/dev/null; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)"):$PATH"; node --version; npm install

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)"):$PATH"; npm run dev
